encounters.name: Under-Sluice Ash-Hound Pack
encounters.introProse: Two gaunt ash-hounds emerge from the steaming culvert shadows, jaws flecked with grey cinders!

victoryOutcome.text: The sluice runnel falls silent as the scavengers scatter into the dark.

encounters.name: Black-Ledger Pier Ambush
encounters.introProse: Dockside cutthroats step out from behind rotting pilings, blades gleaming in the mist!

victoryOutcome.text: You clear the Drowned Piers of Black-Ledger enforcers.

encounters.name: Chancery Bailiff Detachment
encounters.introProse: A brass-plated bailiff bars the Mint alley while an arbalest takes aim from behind a coin-cart!

victoryOutcome.text: The bailiff patrol yields the street.

encounters.name: Foundry Strikebreaker Squad
encounters.introProse: A hissing ash-automaton stomps into the quarry pit flanked by a Furnace Overseer and a chanting bell-mender!

victoryOutcome.text: With the strikebreakers broken, the exhausted quarry laborers raise a hoarse cheer!

encounters.name: Foreman Krag & Kiln Enforcers
encounters.introProse: Foreman Krag steps out of the blazing kiln smoke, brass bellows wheezing inside his chest as his guards lock formation!

victoryOutcome.text: Foreman Krag crashes to the cinders! His furnace manifests expose the Syndicate's manufactured border shortage.

encounters.name: Salt-Jackal Raid on the Viaduct
encounters.introProse: Crystallized salt-jackals bound across the rusted iron sleepers while a shard-kite circles overhead!

victoryOutcome.text: The viaduct beacons burn clear once more.

encounters.name: Bleached Salt-Flats Prowlers
encounters.introProse: Out of the white mineral haze charge a salt-jackal and a drifting mire-wraith!

victoryOutcome.text: The salt-wind disperses the vanquished mist.

encounters.name: Chorus of the Drifting Cairns
encounters.introProse: Two mournful wraiths rise between the shifting cairn stones, whispering forgotten mortal names!

victoryOutcome.text: Quiet settles across the cairns as the wraiths dissolve into pale dust.

encounters.name: Fulgurite Shard-Kite Flock
encounters.introProse: Singing slivers of storm-glass rain down as two shard-kites stoop from the amber clouds!

victoryOutcome.text: Shards of humming quartz litter the glass steppe.

encounters.name: Whispering Mire Haunting
encounters.introProse: Pale lanterns bob across the reeds as a mire-wraith and a rogue bell-cantor set their hounds upon you!

victoryOutcome.text: The reeds fall calm beneath the violet sky.

encounters.name: Sentinels of the Oath-Bridge
encounters.introProse: Two ivory-armored Oath-Broken Sentinels raise their blades in solemn salute before barring the bridge!

victoryOutcome.text: The bridge stands open toward the Threshold Abyss.

encounters.name: Serena of the Weeping Orchard
encounters.introProse: Amber tears fall like glass rain as Serena lowers her lantern-halberd: 'Leave the fallen to sleep, or prove you deserve to pass!'

victoryOutcome.text: Serena sinks to one knee among the glowing roots, her amber armor cracking softly.

encounters.name: Trial of Regent Malcor
encounters.introProse: Regent Malcor rises from the ossuary dais, pale blade drawn: 'If you will not parley with the Unwritten, then earn our seal by steel!'

victoryOutcome.text: Malcor yields the Fragment of Memory with grim respect.

encounters.name: The Echo-Warden of the Vault
encounters.introProse: Obsidian mirrors shatter outward as the Echo-Warden assembles itself in a storm of stolen voices!

victoryOutcome.text: The stolen echoes spiral upward into silence, leaving the Fragment of Quiet behind.

encounters.name: High Auditor Crassus & Chancery Guard
encounters.introProse: High Auditor Crassus raises the Scepter of the Broken Scale beneath the chained First Seal: 'You would plunge Vesper-Threshold into darkness for a fairy tale of rest!'

victoryOutcome.text: High Auditor Crassus falls before the chained silver ring! The fate of the First Seal now rests in your hands.

encounters.name: Guardians of the Amber-Vein
encounters.introProse: A towering Crucible Slag-Golem lumbers from behind a glowing amber pillar as two Slag-Carapace Scuttlers hiss from the slag rubble!

victoryOutcome.text: The Slag-Golem collapses in a shower of cooling glass shards, leaving the Amber-Vein cistern unguarded.

encounters.name: Spire of the Shattered Lens
encounters.introProse: Lightning arcs across the broken brass dome as a Glass-Harpy and twin wraiths swoop down to defend the star-lens platform!

victoryOutcome.text: Static crackles away into the salt wind, clearing the way to the Astral Orrery.

encounters.name: The Silencer of the Buried Bells
encounters.introProse: Heavy iron chains rattle in the gloom. The Bell-Mender Automaton rises from beneath a mound of lead-bound bronze, flanked by two Soot-Automatons!

victoryOutcome.text: With a final mournful chime, the Bell-Mender's mainspring snaps. Across the crypt, the freed bells hum softly in unison.
